sourceSentences: Zaahen empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup and gain 25 bonus range. On-attack, he strikes the target twice.
After 1.5 seconds of using the empowered attack, The Darkin Glaive can be recast within the next 4 seconds at no additional cost, modifying it with a new effect.
Recast: Zaahen empowers his next basic attack within 4 seconds to have an uncancellable windup, gain 25 bonus range, deal bonus physical damage and knock up the target for 0.75 seconds.
Upon reaching maximum range, all enemies hit are dealt physical damage, stunned for 0.25 seconds, and pulled 225 units toward Zaahen.
Both passes of W can generate a stack. Both E swing and R shockwave generate a stack for every champion hit.
Aureate Rush has no minimum dash range.
Aureate Rush's flourish can be performed quicker if the dash stops shortly.
Enemies hit by the outer edge are dealt increased physical damage and bonus magic damage.
The Darkin Glaive and its recast are usable. Dreaded Return and Grim Deliverance are disabled.
If the dash is interrupted, Zaahen will fail to deal damage. Zaahen will, however, deal damage if the dash is interrupted at the very end of its movement, shortly before the damage would occur.
This means he can redirect the damage location if he interrupts the dash by using a blink (such as with Flash) at the correct timing.
Zaahen gains crowd control immunity over the cast time, then launches with displacement immunity into the air to the target location.
Zaahen is unable to act and gains 50% damage reduction from the start of the cast time.
If Zaahen blinks or has his dash otherwise interrupted while ascending into the air, Grim Deliverance's effects are canceled; he will not slam the ground.
Upon the resurrection being triggered, all summoner spells that are not already on cooldown are placed on a 5-second cooldown.
[Skill-Capped] The first is Q2, then W. The guaranteed knockdown of Q ensures the throwing of power W for a long series of control blocking.
[Skill-Capped] executing Q on a follower, then approaching with the ability E or a lightning move, and executing Q2 then W for one of the best track support setups in the game.
[Skill-Capped] By pressing W before the lightning move, you hide the long motion effects, which helps you catch enemies suddenly.
[Skill-Capped] if you try to use the Blitz while executing an E, you will cancel the rip strike instead, and you will not do any damage, unless you know the perfect timing.
[Skill-Capped] Be sure to hit your enemies with the outer edge of the weapon strike, as you will inflict damage proportional to your opponent's maximum health as bonus damage.
[Skill-Capped] hitting the target with the W ability will immediately grant you two latent stacks for each hero drawn
